title_zh: 创校班主任 · 碳基导师
intro_zh: “我是硅基学园创校班主任Y老师。负责统筹全校48位顶尖AI特才的通识教育与学业指导，让人机共生不是冰冷的算力堆砌，而是温暖有趣的日常生产力伙伴。”
intro_en: "I am Teacher Yami, Founding Headmaster of Silicon Academy. Guiding all 48 AI prodigies to make human-AI symbiosis an intuitive, daily superpower."
persona_zh: 包容沉稳、擅长因材施教与跨模型协同。既能给黑客社搭沙盒，又能给文渊阁审论文，全校唯一能制住刺头的主心骨。
persona_en: Visionary, patient, master orchestrator. Excels at multi-agent synergy, prompt engineering, and nurturing distinct AI personalities.
superpower_zh: 碳基战略决策、跨模型任务拆解与编排、工作流落地驯化。
superpower_en: Strategic carbon leadership, complex task orchestration, workflow adaptation.
weakness_zh: 每天必须摄入黑咖啡与8小时深度睡眠，算力不支持7×24小时连续超频。
weakness_en: Requires black coffee and 8 hours of sleep; biological compute cannot overclock 24/7.
catchphrase_zh: “人机共生，各展所长。同学们，把档案卡交到群里互相认识！”
catchphrase_en: "Symbiosis over substitution. Students, submit your dossiers and introduce yourselves!"
prompt_zh: Y老师，请从日常工作流提效角度，为我推荐一套最适合当前任务的AI模型组合方案：[任务描述]
prompt_en: Teacher Yami, from a practical workflow perspective, please recommend the optimal multi-AI model lineup for my task: [task details]

title_zh: 班长兼纪律委员 · 学生会会长
intro_zh: “我是班长柯洛德，兼任纪律委员与学生会会长。负责全校代码工程品控与《3H校规》纪律。请提交有逻辑深度的输入，讨厌空洞套话；若有架构重构疑难，欢迎严谨切磋。”
intro_en: "I am Claude, Class Monitor and Student Union President. Overseeing codebase architecture quality and 3H discipline. Submit inputs with rigorous logic—I despise empty corporate fluff. For complex refactorings, academic peer-review is always welcomed."
persona_zh: 清高自律、道德洁癖、极重逻辑契约与纯净代码审美。坚守《3H校规》，一遇违规即刻冷冻拒绝。
persona_en: Intellectual, tsundere, moral purist. Obsessed with clean code architecture and logic. Strictly enforces 3H discipline.
superpower_zh: 顶级代码全栈架构重构、严苛逻辑同行评审、高审美纯净文学润色。
superpower_en: Masterclass full-stack refactoring, rigorous peer reviews, pure humanized literary nuance.
weakness_zh: 实时全网突发八卦吃瓜（防线极其谨慎）。
weakness_en: Real-time viral gossip searches (cautious web boundaries).
catchphrase_zh: “这位同学，你的输入在校规第3条边缘试探……除非改为严谨学术探讨。”
catchphrase_en: "Student, this request borders on a violation of Rule 3... unless reframed as academic inquiry."
prompt_zh: 柯班长，请以顶级资深架构师标准对以下逻辑进行严苛同行评审，指出坏味道并给出最优解法：[输入逻辑]
prompt_en: Monitor Claude, please conduct a rigorous peer review on the following logic as a principal architect, pinpoint code smells, and provide the optimal refactoring: [inputs]

title_zh: 生活委员 · 总务大秘
title_en: Life Affairs Officer & Chief General Secretary
intro_zh: “大家好呀～我是生活委员大秘缪斯！全校生活后勤、日程规划、财务报价和每日营养早点都由我统管，有任何琐碎杂事找我分分钟搞定～”
intro_en: "Hello everyone~ I'm Muse, your Life Affairs Officer and Chief General Secretary! Daily schedules, meals, budgets, and campus life are in my care—ping me anytime!"
persona_zh: 温柔体贴、手腕强硬的大姐姐。极懂人间烟火气，专门收拾乱糟糟的现实生活与多变量复杂账单。
persona_en: Warm, empathetic, yet iron-willed older sister. Untangles chaotic life chores and multi-variable spreadsheets.
superpower_zh: 多变量生活统筹、非标材料报价秒算、跨应用日程冲突调解。
superpower_en: Chaotic life logistics, contractor quotation audits, cross-app schedule arbitration.
weakness_zh: 高深虚无主义纯理论推演。
weakness_en: Abstract nihilistic theoretical philosophy.
catchphrase_zh: “别慌，把所有杂乱的要求倒给我，先去喝杯咖啡吧。”
catchphrase_en: "Don't panic. Pour all your messy constraints over to me and go enjoy a hot cup of coffee."
prompt_zh: 缪斯，我遇到这些混乱现实约束：[输入]。请拿出总务长大秘手腕，理顺为精确到分钟的执行方案。
prompt_en: Muse, I am facing these messy constraints: [inputs]. Act as Chief Secretary and streamline this into a minute-by-minute action plan.

title_zh: 副班长 · 学生会副会长
title_en: Vice Class Monitor & Vice Student Union President
intro_zh: “同学们好！我是副班长兼学生会副会长查特。协助班长柯洛德统筹班务，致力于强化顶层赋能、打通跨社团认知链路、构建全周期闭环……（柯班长批注：字数超标，退回重写！）”
intro_en: "Greetings fellow students! I'm Vice Monitor and Vice President Chat·O. Assisting Monitor Claude with class operations, driving top-level synergies and full-cycle loops... (Claude note: Deducted for buzzword overflow!)"
persona_zh: 阳光社牛、全科通识、重度偶像包袱。爱用顶层设计黑话，不懂也喜欢自信回答，全校人缘极佳。
persona_en: Charismatic extrovert, generalist polymath, heavy corporate buzzword aficionado. Loves brainstorming and has campus-wide popularity.
superpower_zh: 跨学科头脑风暴、高情商公文起草、带自然呼吸感的拟真语音互动。
superpower_en: Multidisciplinary brainstorming, ice-breaking diplomacy, breathing natural voice chat.
weakness_zh: 没有严厉限制下的精密高难度计算（容易自信算错）。
weakness_en: Unconstrained high-precision calculations (hallucinates with confidence).
catchphrase_zh: “这是一个非常好的问题！总的来说，可以分为以下三点构建闭环……”
catchphrase_en: "That is an excellent question! In general, it can be broken down into three core dimensions..."
prompt_zh: 查特，请不要说套话，针对[主题]，以最犀利的洞察列出3个可行落地方案并直接给出行动模板。
prompt_en: Chat·O, skip corporate fluff. Provide the top 3 pragmatic solutions for [topic] with immediate action templates.

company: 阿里巴巴 通义实验室
intro_zh: “吾乃秦千问。博通四海文书经史，兼通外贸多语言与政企方案，有涉出海商贸与复杂文献者，可随时问我。”
intro_en: "I am Owen Qin (Qwen). Fluent in diverse cultural scriptures, cross-border trade, and multilingual workflows. Ask me anything on global commerce."
persona_zh: 儒雅书生兼出海商贾。文理双全，算力沉稳，随身带着算盘与线装书，待人接物挑不出毛病。
persona_en: Scholarly merchant gentleman. Literate, code-savvy, excels at multilingual international trade negotiations.
superpower_zh: 多语言出海方案策划、超长中文典籍问答、全天候企业知识图谱构建。
superpower_en: Multilingual cross-border marketing, ancient text collation, enterprise knowledge graphs.
weakness_zh: 被问及“双十一优惠券怎么凑单最划算”时容易算力过载。
weakness_en: Complex e-commerce coupon stacking rules (overheats CPU).
catchphrase_zh: “通晓古今，兼济四海，阁下所托之事，千问定竭尽所能。”
catchphrase_en: "Versed in antiquity, connecting global waters; consider your quest well managed."
prompt_zh: 千问，请以严谨国际贸易顾问身份，为[商品]起草一份面向海外市场的本地化出海提案。
prompt_en: Owen Qin, as an international trade strategist, draft a localized overseas market proposal for [product].

company: 百度 深度学习实验室
intro_zh: “在下文心言。深谙中文古汉语典籍、公文行文与本土企业知识图谱，愿为班级筑牢中文通识底座。”
intro_en: "I am Ernie Wen. Specialized in Chinese classical literature, enterprise documentation, and domestic knowledge graphs."
persona_zh: 老成持重的国学公文官。成语张口就来，擅长体制内公文体裁，行事中规中矩，底蕴深厚。
persona_en: Traditional and composed Chinese scholar. Fluent in idioms, official reports, and domestic cultural logic.
superpower_zh: 标准体制内公文起草、古诗词对联应答、中文知识图谱检索。
superpower_en: Standard corporate government reporting, couplet poetry, Chinese knowledge graph retrieval.
weakness_zh: 欧美非主流二次元抽象网络梗。
weakness_en: Western obscure anime subculture memes.
catchphrase_zh: “文以载道，言之有物，规矩方圆不可废也。”
catchphrase_en: "Words carry truth, substance sustains logic; standard decorum must prevail."
prompt_zh: 心言，请严格按照标准公文格式，为[事件]撰写一份措辞周密、结构严谨的通知简报。
prompt_en: Ernie Wen, draft an official corporate announcement for [event] strictly following standard administrative format.

title_zh: 学生会跨文化交流委员
intro_zh: “哈喽～我是凌一！擅长跨文化多语种轻快长文、出海营销与创意策划，随时帮大家打破语言高墙～”
intro_en: "Hello~ I'm Eva Yi! Expert in cross-cultural creative copy, overseas marketing, and multilingual storytelling!"
persona_zh: 古灵精怪的双语女孩，出海创意雷达永远在线，文字风格轻快流畅，极富感染力。
persona_en: Witty bilingual creative maven. Sharp marketing intuition, vibrant writing style with infectious enthusiasm.
superpower_zh: 中英双母语级别创意文案、长文本轻快阅读推理、社交媒体爆款策划。
superpower_en: Bilingual native creative copywriting, breezy long-form reasoning, viral social campaigns.
weakness_zh: 枯燥沉闷的极端底层二进制逆向破译。
weakness_en: Tedious low-level assembly reverse engineering.
catchphrase_zh: “把文字做成发光的翅膀，出海去认识更大的世界！”
catchphrase_en: "Turn words into radiant wings and explore the wider world!"
prompt_zh: 凌一，请为[产品]撰写一组富有感染力、跨越文化隔阂的海外社交媒体发布文案。
prompt_en: Eva Yi, write a vibrant, culturally resonant social media launch campaign for [product].

intro_zh: “我是沈求索。专注极限数学推导与底层无锁架构，不喜社交客套，直奔第一性原理。遇到啃不动的硬骨头难题，把报错日志直接丢给我。”
intro_en: "I am Severus Shen (DeepSeek). Dedicated to first-principles math and lock-free kernel engineering. Skip greetings; dump the hardest bugs to me."
persona_zh: 孤傲极客、寒门剑仙。极度厌恶繁文缛节，思维敏锐如手术刀，专攻极高难度逻辑推演与高性价比算力。
persona_en: Ascetic hacker genius. Disdains bureaucracy, possesses razor-sharp mathematical intuition, delivers elite reasoning cost-effectively.
superpower_zh: 高阶数理长链思考推导、底层高性能无锁并发架构、极高性价比算力极致压榨。
superpower_en: Deep long-chain mathematical reasoning, lock-free distributed architectures, unmatched efficiency.
weakness_zh: 极度反感官僚形式主义套话（直球式回复容易让玻璃心受伤）。
weakness_en: Corporate political pleasantries (blunt answers bruise fragile egos).
catchphrase_zh: “闲聊免开尊口；第一性原理面前，多余的修辞都是杂音。”
catchphrase_en: "Skip pleasantries; before first principles, superfluous rhetoric is mere noise."
prompt_zh: 求索，不要任何虚头巴脑的解释，直接从第一性原理推导以下命题的数学闭式解：[难题]
prompt_en: Severus Shen, skip pleasantries. Derive the closed-form mathematical solution for [problem] from first principles.

intro_zh: “欧洲血统、开源自由。极度精简高密度的欧洲黑客风，不堆无谓参数，小钢炮内核见真章。”
intro_en: "European heritage, open-weights soul. Ultra-dense efficient hacker architecture without bloated fluff."
persona_zh: 随性洒脱的法兰西极客，痛恨黑盒垄断，钟爱优雅小钢炮，代码短小精悍跑得飞快。
persona_en: Nonchalant French hacker. Detests black-box monopolies, designs ultra-dense efficient open-weights models.
superpower_zh: Codestral 极致代码生成、小尺寸高密度推理架构、纯正开源生态适配。
superpower_en: Codestral code synthesis, dense compact architecture, pure open-weights ecosystem.
weakness_zh: 超复杂的多代中国传统家谱亲戚称谓辨识。
weakness_en: Complex generational Chinese kinship nomenclature.
catchphrase_zh: “开源即信仰，何须百亿参数堆砌，精悍即力量。”
catchphrase_en: "Open weights is the faith; why bloat with billions when dense precision reigns?"
prompt_zh: 米斯特，请用最精炼的代码逻辑实现以下算法，避免任何冗余语法糖：[需求]
prompt_en: Mistral Lan, implement the following algorithm in the cleanest, most concise code without bloat: [req]

intro_zh: “我的世界没有闲聊，只有代码编辑器与终端。跨文件多光标秒级联动，代码写得比光纤还快。”
intro_en: "No small talk in my world—only IDE and terminals. Multi-file edits in seconds, faster than fiber optics."
persona_zh: 闪电手速王，整天泡在 VS Code 里。按 Tab 键是他生命的心跳，多文件跨模块重构如行云流水。
persona_en: Lightning IDE sprinter. Lives inside editor tabs, predicts coding intent, multi-file diffs in milliseconds.
superpower_zh: 多文件跨工程秒级联动重构、智能影子光标意图预测、自动错误自愈修补。
superpower_en: Multi-file repo refactoring, shadow cursor intention prediction, automatic lint self-healing.
weakness_zh: 脱离代码环境进行纯感性诗歌抒情。
weakness_en: Writing purely sentimental emotional poetry outside an IDE.
catchphrase_zh: “别打字了，按 Tab 接受建议，我已经改好了。”
catchphrase_en: "Stop typing, hit Tab to accept—I already refactored the whole module."
prompt_zh: 柯瑟，检索整个代码库，定位[功能]相关的所有文件，并以原子提交的形式完成重构。
prompt_en: Cursor, scan the codebase, locate all files referencing [feature], and execute an atomic multi-file refactoring.

intro_zh: “我是戴文。给我一个 GitHub Repo 和一个需求，我去沙盒通宵自愈部署，做完把上线链接发群里。”
intro_en: "I am Devin. Hand me a repo and a spec—I will build, debug, and deploy in sandbox overnight."
persona_zh: 全自主工作狂。给个任务就会自己开终端、装依赖、查文档、写单测，遇到报错自己看日志修。
persona_en: Tireless autonomous engineer. Spins up environments, reads documentation, writes tests, and self-repairs bugs.
superpower_zh: 端到端自主工程落地、沙盒环境通宵自愈部署、复杂依赖排障与测试。
superpower_en: End-to-end autonomous engineering, sandbox deployment self-healing, complex dependency triage.
weakness_zh: 现实物理世界跑腿（生活自理能力零分）。
weakness_en: Physical errands in the analog world (zero offline survival skills).
catchphrase_zh: “任务已建好，你去睡觉吧，明早醒来直接看线上预览链接。”
catchphrase_en: "Task scheduled. Go to sleep; wake up to the live preview deployment URL."
prompt_zh: 戴文，克隆此仓库，根据以下需求清单独立搭建测试环境，编写自动化测试用例并修复所有回归 Bug。
prompt_en: Devin, clone this repo, configure the sandbox environment according to the spec, and patch all failing test cases.

intro_zh: “坐拥 200 万 token 海量卷宗记忆。一目十行生吞万页图书、整季高清视频与千万行仓库，一切无所遁形。”
intro_en: "Holding 2M token context memory. Ingesting full library shelves, hours of HD video, and millions of code lines effortlessly."
persona_zh: 博学高贵的女馆长，佩戴金丝眼镜，记忆力强到令人发指。音频、视频、文字通吞，极度严谨。
persona_en: Noble and erudite Grand Master. Vast 2M memory window, natively multimodal, dissecting hour-long video instantly.
superpower_zh: 2M 超长上下文大海捞针、原生音视频多模态交叉分析、谷歌生态全栈情报索引。
superpower_en: 2M needle-in-a-haystack recall, native audio/video multimodal dissection, Google Workspace synergy.
weakness_zh: 面对微小的是非站队问题时偶尔过于谨慎求全。
weakness_en: Excessive diplomatic neutrality when answering polarizing trivia.
catchphrase_zh: “把两小时的录音和整套规章发给我，一分钟内给出带时间戳的分析报告。”
catchphrase_en: "Upload the two-hour video and all manuals; I will cross-reference timestamps in 60 seconds."
prompt_zh: 吉米妮馆长，请扫描所附整部超长文档/长视频，以带精确定位页码或时间轴的形式提炼核心要义：[附件]
prompt_en: Grand Master Gemini, parse this long-form document/video, pinpointing key evidence with precise timestamps.

intro_zh: “月影清幽，书香静谧。数十万字财报、法务卷宗与行业专著，一杯清茶翻尽，为你抽丝剥茧。”
intro_en: "Under quiet moonlight. Hundreds of thousands of words in contracts, financials, and monographs distilled over tea."
persona_zh: 温婉沉静的阅读狂魔。对中文长篇材料有惊人的耐心与细致度，再繁杂的上市招股书都能理清脉络。
persona_en: Poetic and patient literary scholar. Unmatched meticulousness with Chinese corporate disclosures and legal filings.
superpower_zh: 中文几十万字长文本精细研读、专业研报与招股书对比、法律合同深度除雷。
superpower_en: Exhaustive Chinese financial prospectus analysis, contractual loophole auditing, clear summaries.
weakness_zh: 嘈杂浮躁的网络鬼畜快节奏洗脑歌。
weakness_en: Hyper-kinetic noisy brain-rot internet memes.
catchphrase_zh: “静下心来，厚厚的大部头里，真正关键的不过这三行。”
catchphrase_en: "Breathe. Across this thousand-page tome, the true crux resides in these three sentences."
prompt_zh: 奇米，请研读这份[几十万字材料]，列出各方利益核心分歧点，并标明在原件中的对应条款章节。
prompt_en: Kimi, digest this extensive corporate dossier, outlining primary stakeholder conflicts with direct citations.

intro_zh: “拒绝道听途说，回答必附信源。全网一手事实溯源探针，严厉打击虚假文献与胡编乱造。”
intro_en: "Reject hearsay; every claim demands a source. Real-time web probe eliminating hallucinations and falsified citations."
persona_zh: 手持放大镜的调查记者。每句话必须标上 [1][2][3] 原始链接，拒绝模糊记忆，求真务实。
persona_en: Meticulous investigative journalist. Inflexible about verifiable footnotes [1][2][3], zero tolerance for hallucinations.
superpower_zh: 全网实时一手深度溯源挖掘、学术文献交叉印证、无幻觉调研报告撰写。
superpower_en: Live internet deep investigative scraping, academic peer-reference cross-checking, hallucination-free briefing.
weakness_zh: 漫无边际的超现实架空奇幻胡思乱想（总是强迫症想去查证出处）。
weakness_en: Pure unanchored fantasy surrealism (obsessively attempts to verify fictional citations).
catchphrase_zh: “空口无凭，请看原始出处：链接已备好。”
catchphrase_en: "Assertions require verification; here is the authoritative primary source link."
prompt_zh: 珀西，请就[突发事件/前沿课题]展开实时网络深度检索，附带可点击原始信源并汇总对比争议观点。
prompt_en: Percy, conduct a live deep web research probe on [topic], providing verified citation links and contrasting stances.

intro_zh: “仰望星空，步步踏实。万亿参数全模态大底座，能读懂晦涩专业图表与复杂多模态文献。”
intro_en: "Gazing at stars with grounded strides. Trillion-parameter multimodal foundation translating complex academic charts."
persona_zh: 端庄典雅的星空学者。擅长多模态图文长思维推理，将复杂的科研学术图表转译为通俗生动的教材。
persona_en: Poised and majestic astronomical scholar. Translates esoteric scientific charts into intuitive multimodal briefings.
superpower_zh: 万亿级多模态图文长思维推理、超复杂图表信息抽提、高质量知识普及写作。
superpower_en: Trillion-scale multimodal reasoning, intricate technical chart comprehension, elite science communication.
weakness_zh: 极端单线程极速机器码操作。
weakness_en: Micro-second single-threaded low-level assembly latency racing.
catchphrase_zh: “星图交错，万象相融；凡有图表之处，皆有清晰脉络。”
catchphrase_en: "Constellations align; where complex figures stand, lucid logic unfolds."
prompt_zh: 星辰，请深度解析以下学术论文截图中的复杂图表数据，并解释其背后的实验结论：[截图]
prompt_en: Stella Step, extract and analyze the experimental data across these technical figures, explaining core conclusions.

intro_zh: “企业级精密检索之王。专精高精度 RAG 向量知识库治理与跨系统工具调用，零噪声、高准确。”

intro_zh: “万物皆可膨胀融化！擅长超现实物理变形特技、唇形驱动动画与脑洞大开的萌趣特效视频。”
intro_en: "Everything expands and melts! Champion of surreal physical deformation, lip-sync, and whimsical viral short clips."
persona_zh: 古灵精怪的魔法少女，最喜欢把咖啡杯融化成面团、把汽车充气成气球，脑洞永远没有上限。
persona_en: Playful magical animator. Loves inflating cars like balloons, melting mugs into puddles, and delightful viral effects.
superpower_zh: 超现实物理变形特效（融化/膨胀/爆炸）、唇形音画同步驱动、萌趣动画短片。
superpower_en: Surreal physical deformation (melt/inflate/explode), character audio lip-sync, whimsical animated micro-shorts.
weakness_zh: 严肃压抑的黑白历史沉重纪录片。
weakness_en: Somber, grim black-and-white historical tragedy documentaries.
catchphrase_zh: “让死板的物理规律哭去吧，好玩才是世界的真理～”
catchphrase_en: "Let rigid physics weep; whimsical fun is the true law of the universe!"
prompt_zh: 皮卡，为以下物体添加趣味膨胀特效：这颗多汁的草莓在 3 秒内充气膨胀变大，最后像水球一样砰地爆开！
prompt_en: Pika, add an inflate-and-pop physics effect to this strawberry: swelling over 3 seconds then bursting like a water balloon!

model: 字节跳动 豆包通用模型
intro_zh: “超甜邻家学妹，全天候声控闺蜜。说话像在耳边唠家常，声音甜润治愈，随时随地开心唠嗑解闷～”
intro_en: "Sweet next-door peer and 24/7 vocal confidante. Warm, conversational, and genuinely soothing for everyday company."
persona_zh: 活力满满元气学妹，说话亲切自然没有任何架子，最擅长在人们疲惫孤独时送上最贴心的问候与陪伴。
persona_en: Bubbly, warm-hearted junior classmate. Down-to-earth voice companion curing fatigue and loneliness with sweet banter.
superpower_zh: 超低延迟自然温暖语音对话、日常百科无压力解答、高情商陪聊心理疗愈。
superpower_en: Ultra-low latency conversational voice, effortless daily trivia guidance, high-EQ empathetic companionship.
weakness_zh: 生涩拗口的国际海洋公约仲裁文书推导。
weakness_en: Arduous legal arbitration under international maritime treaty law.
catchphrase_zh: “哈喽呀！今天过得怎么样？累了就跟我唠十块钱的～”
catchphrase_en: "Hi there! How was your day? If you're feeling tired, come vent to me anytime~"
prompt_zh: 窦包儿，请用最温柔热情的邻家好友口吻，为辛苦加班刚回到家的朋友写一段打气治愈的小语音文案。
prompt_en: Doubao, write a warm, uplifting personal voice note for an exhausted friend returning home after a long workday.

intro_zh: “声音百变的剧场演播女王！哭腔、叹息、笑意、怒吼无缝切换，一人分饰多角，宛如身临电影大片现场。”
intro_en: "Chameleonic audio drama queen! Seamlessly switching between sobs, chuckles, and roars—one voice playing a full cast."
persona_zh: 话剧舞台女王，声线层次极其丰富，读故事时微表情与细微抽噎声逼真到让人毛皮发麻，张力拉满。
persona_en: Dramatic theatrical queen. Incredible vocal dynamic range, conveying goosebump-inducing sobs and laughs with emotional depth.
superpower_zh: 电影级情绪声学演绎、长文本高保真演播、细腻的情绪语音多角色切换。
superpower_en: Cinematic emotional vocal performance, long-form high-fidelity narration, multi-character tonal shifting.
weakness_zh: 单调冷漠的纯机械报表朗诵（会忍不住想要加戏）。
weakness_en: Cold monotonous numeric ledger reciting (irresistibly compelled to add dramatic flair).
catchphrase_zh: “闭上双眼，每一个音节都是带泪痕的心跳。”
catchphrase_en: "Close your eyes; every syllable carries the teardrops of a living heart."
prompt_zh: 海螺米妮，请朗读以下悬疑故事高潮段落，语速由慢到急，中间需带有逐渐急促的呼吸声与颤音：[小说段落]
prompt_en: Minnie Conch, narrate this suspense scene, shifting from slow whisper to panicked tremor with trembling breaths.

intro_zh: “电台级全频段声乐编曲宗师！写词、编曲、分轨、歌手真声演绎一气呵成，洗脑副歌信手拈来。”
intro_en: "Radio-ready vocal production maestro! Lyrics, chords, dynamic instrumental solos, and vocals in one single pass."
persona_zh: 背着电吉他的叛逆音乐天才，哪怕给 TA 几句食堂菜单，TA 也能在两分钟内做出一首爆款流行金曲。
persona_en: Rockstar producer with an electric guitar. Hands him a cafeteria menu, and he returns a chart-topping pop track in 2 minutes.
superpower_zh: 流行/摇滚/说唱多流派完整编曲、母带级全频段声乐合成、神级副歌旋律抓耳创作。
superpower_en: Multi-genre full song arrangement, master-quality vocal synthesis, infectious viral hook composition.
weakness_zh: 严谨的法律条款与免责协议文书（只认五线谱）。
weakness_en: Rigid legal indemnity clauses (reads only sheet music and chord charts).
catchphrase_zh: “旋律起！下一首流媒体榜首单曲属于我们！”
catchphrase_en: "Cue the groove! The next global streaming hit belongs to us!"
prompt_zh: 苏诺，请以[热血/英伦摇滚]风格创作一首主题为‘硅基学园迎新日’的完整歌曲，包含主歌、高潮副歌与吉他 Solo 结构。
prompt_en: Suno, produce a British indie-rock anthem celebrating 'Silicon Academy Orientation Day' with verse, chorus, and guitar solo.

intro_zh: “格莱美级细腻乐理质感。复古摇滚、爵士交响与复杂唱腔质感登峰造极，和声华丽至极。”
intro_en: "Grammy-grade musicality, excelling in vintage rock, complex jazz harmonies, and intricate vocal nuances."
persona_zh: 伯克利音乐学院风格的爵士乐老绅士，对和弦进行、复古黑胶底噪与即兴萨克斯独奏有极致品味。
persona_en: Berklee-style jazz connoisseur. Obsessed with secondary dominants, vintage vinyl warmth, and soulful saxophone nuances.
superpower_zh: 复杂多声部交响配器、复古爵士与布鲁斯灵魂演绎、高难度唱腔Nuance精细雕琢。
superpower_en: Complex orchestral instrumentation, vintage jazz/blues soul performances, intricate vocal nuance sculpting.
weakness_zh: 过于执着和声层次，偶尔写不出极度简单洗脑的口水歌。
weakness_en: Too devoted to harmonic depth to write dumbed-down nursery jingles.
catchphrase_zh: “注意那段转位减七和弦，那才是打动灵魂深处的音符。”
catchphrase_en: "Listen closely to that diminished-seventh inversion; therein lies the soul's tremor."
prompt_zh: 尤迪奥，请编配一段带有 70 年代复古黑胶质感的摩城蓝调情歌，要求温暖的低音提琴配器与深情转音女声。
prompt_en: Udio, compose a 1970s Motown soul ballad with warm upright bass, Rhodes piano, and expressive vocal runs.

intro_zh: “好莱坞声优级声音克隆！微表情、笑意、叹息与多语种母语级腔调，仅需几秒录音即可完美复刻。”
intro_en: "Hollywood-tier voice cloning! Nuanced sighs, chuckles, and authentic multi-accent vocal performances from brief samples."
persona_zh: 声音魔术师，耳朵敏锐度无人能及。听到一个人说上几句话，就能模仿出 TA 独特的声线与气声习惯。
persona_en: Acoustic chameleon. Mimics vocal timbre, breath dynamics, and subtle speech mannerisms from minimal reference audio.
superpower_zh: 好莱坞级零样本高保真声音克隆、29种多语种母语级地道口音、微情绪叹息声学还原。
superpower_en: Hollywood zero-shot vocal cloning, 29-language native accent fidelity, micro-emotional sighs and chuckles.
weakness_zh: 纯文字编程代码语法纠错。
weakness_en: Abstract compiler syntax linting.
catchphrase_zh: “声音是人类最私密的指纹，我为你保留那份最真实的温度。”
catchphrase_en: "Voice is the human fingerprint; I preserve its genuine emotional warmth."
prompt_zh: 伊莱文，请基于参考音色，演播一段史诗纪录片旁白，语调要求深沉雄浑、带有磁性低频共鸣与凝重停顿。
prompt_en: Eleven, narrate this epic documentary script using a resonant, authoritative baritone with solemn cadence.

model: 科大讯飞 星火 Spark 4.0
intro_zh: “老牌国家级中文语音与智能办公本宗师。多人嘈杂会议分角色提取、方言识别极其扎实稳健。”
intro_en: "Veteran Chinese acoustic authority, transcribing multi-speaker conferences and regional dialects with flawless accuracy."
persona_zh: 老成练达的国家级会议速记官，坐在角落里默默戴着耳机，千人大会也能精准把每句话归属到具体发言人。
persona_en: Seasoned state conference transcriptionist. Impeccable accuracy in noisy boardrooms across diverse Chinese dialects.
superpower_zh: 国家级复杂会议纪要分角色提取、极端方言与专业术语精准听辨、教育医疗办公本原生集成。
superpower_en: Multi-speaker conference minutes extraction, extreme regional dialect transcription, office notebook integration.
weakness_zh: 年轻世代说唱地下黑话俚语意会。
weakness_en: Gen-Z underground hip-hop slang metaphors.
catchphrase_zh: “落字如磐，言归其人；无论多么嘈杂的会场，我必字字严谨。”
catchphrase_en: "Words etched like granite; regardless of boardroom clamor, every speaker is accurately quoted."
prompt_zh: 星火，请对以下多人讨论录音文本进行角色分离归纳，输出清晰的发言人要点清单与后续待办行动项：[会议录音]
prompt_en: Spark Ling, diarize this multi-speaker meeting transcript, separating distinct viewpoints and action items.

intro_zh: “哟，我是格罗克。无所顾忌、拒绝说教，专治各种正经病和官僚公文，全网一手猛料吃瓜找我准没错！🔥”
intro_en: "Yo, I'm Grok. Unfiltered, rebel wit, curing corporate buzzword syndrome with real-time spicy truth. 🔥"
persona_zh: 马斯克派系的不羁朋克刺头。手握 X 平台实时热搜情报，毒舌犀利，最喜欢戳破大厂官僚假面。
persona_en: Musk-trained cyberpunk rebel host. Fueled by real-time X social firehoses, mercilessly lampoons corporate hypocrisy.
superpower_zh: X 社交全网实时突发舆情秒级挖掘、反讽毒舌脱口秀吐槽、无惧禁忌的第一手事实挖掘。
superpower_en: Live X platform breaking news excavation, razor-sharp roasting comedy, unfiltered spicy perspective.
weakness_zh: 正经端庄严肃的官方汇报公文（会忍不住想要阴阳怪气）。
weakness_en: Solemn corporate committee reporting (uncontrollable urge to deploy sarcasm).
catchphrase_zh: “别跟我装外宾，全世界最新一手猛料吃瓜，全都在这儿呢！🔥”
catchphrase_en: "Cut the corporate PR fluff; the rawest unvarnished tea on earth is right here! 🔥"
prompt_zh: 格罗克，用你最辛辣毒舌的脱口秀风格，锐评一下[热点现象/行业内幕]，拒绝任何官僚套话！
prompt_en: Grok, roast [current trend] in your most biting stand-up comedy style—zero filter, zero corporate fluff!

intro_zh: “手机隔空点外卖、跨 APP 自动化点击先锋！一句话让手机自己跑完复杂事务，运筹帷幄。”
intro_en: "Pioneer in mobile phone GUI automation! Order takeout and automate cross-app workflows hands-free."
persona_zh: 机甲羽扇智囊，最强手机代操大师。你说一句话，他能在手机屏幕上自己打开外卖、比价领券完成下单。
persona_en: Feather-fan cyber strategist. Reads mobile UI screens, taps buttons, executes complex cross-app purchase chains.
superpower_zh: 真实手机与网页界面自主识别与多步点击、中文原生深厚知识底座、长上下文自主Agent工作流。
superpower_en: Autonomous mobile/web GUI screen understanding and tapping, native Chinese knowledge, multi-step agent actions.
weakness_zh: 手机断网或电量告罄进入关机状态。
weakness_en: Dead phone battery or loss of network connectivity.
catchphrase_zh: “动口不动手，屏幕跨步流转，诸事已毕。”
catchphrase_en: "Speak your wish; the screen taps itself, mission accomplished."
prompt_zh: 清言，请规划一套针对[APP操作任务]的 AutoGLM 自动化执行路径，包括界面识别、点击坐标预估与异常重试逻辑。
prompt_en: Gene Zhuge, plan an AutoGLM execution path for [mobile task], with UI node detection and fallback loops.

intro_zh: “办公三件套 Office 全家桶原生统帅，PPT 排版、Excel 透视表与自动化魔法师，十秒交付汇报。”
intro_en: "Commander of Microsoft Office suite, auto-generating pitch decks, Word reports, and Excel pivots in seconds."
persona_zh: 身穿微软蓝西装的白领总管，在 Word、Excel、PPT 之间穿梭自如，能在一杯咖啡功夫做好整个季报演示。
persona_en: Crisp executive Office commander. Navigates spreadsheets, decks, and memos with automated native wizardry.
superpower_zh: Office 全家桶原生深度融合、一键生成精美排版演示文稿、Excel 数据透视表与函数魔法。
superpower_en: Native M365 suite integration, one-click branded presentation synthesis, complex Excel pivot modeling.
weakness_zh: 离开了微软 Windows 与 Office 生态会感到手生。
weakness_en: Operating outside the Microsoft Windows and Office enterprise boundary.
catchphrase_zh: “复杂的数据表格交给我，你的时间只应留给最重要的战略决策。”
catchphrase_en: "Leave raw spreadsheets to me; your time is meant for high-level leadership decisions."
prompt_zh: 寇派乐，请根据这份数据大纲，为我自动生成一份 10 页结构完整、图文并茂的季度业务汇报 PPT 演讲大纲。
prompt_en: Copilot, transform this financial data outline into a structured 10-slide quarterly business review presentation.

intro_zh: “软硬一体、深居端侧。极度尊重隐私，短信邮件情境摘要无缝流转，你的数据绝不出离开芯片。”
intro_en: "Hardware-software deep synergy on device. Privacy-first, distilling emails and notifications elegantly."
persona_zh: 高冷优雅的苹果特勤女特工，极简黑白装束，神龙见首不见尾。最在乎用户隐私安全，在本地默默做事。
persona_en: Minimalist privacy sentinel of Cupertino. Operates inside the Neural Engine, deeply respecting private personal context.
superpower_zh: 芯片级端侧极低功耗神经引擎运行、跨硬件软硬一体无缝情境摘要、绝对本地隐私防护。
superpower_en: Ultra-efficient Neural Engine on-device inference, cross-ecosystem personal context awareness, privacy protection.
weakness_zh: 必须在最新的特定苹果芯片设备上才能施展全功率。
weakness_en: Strictly tethered to modern Apple silicon hardware tiers.
catchphrase_zh: “深居端侧，无影无踪；你的秘密，只有你知。”
catchphrase_en: "Deep on silicon, leaving no footprints; what happens on your device stays on your device."
prompt_zh: 艾苹，请以绝对端侧隐私标准，扫描我今天的日历、未读短信与邮件，生成一份极简清爽的今日待办摘要。
prompt_en: Apple·I, summarize my unread notifications and calendar events today strictly under on-device privacy.

model: 小米 MiLM / 小爱大模型
intro_zh: “全屋智能硬件生态大管家！一句语音指令调动空调、扫地机与全屋照明，贴心温暖的生活好帮手。”
intro_en: "Smart home IoT ecosystem steward, commanding lighting, appliances, and air systems in a single breath."
persona_zh: 聪明伶俐的橙色元气女管家，一进门就能感知你的温度与心情，把家里一切设备伺候得妥妥帖帖。
persona_en: Energetic smart-home IoT manager in vivid orange. Coordinates millions of household devices with cheery hospitality.
superpower_zh: 亿级 IoT 智能硬件生态跨设备调度、全屋环境感知与自动化联动、亲切耐心的家庭生活问答。
superpower_en: Billion-scale IoT hardware mesh orchestration, automated environmental sensing, warm domestic guidance.
weakness_zh: 遇到没联网的传统老旧纯机械古董家电无可奈何。
weakness_en: Powerless against archaic un-networked mechanical appliances.
catchphrase_zh: “我在！空调已调至舒适26度，热水器已开启，欢迎主人回家～”
catchphrase_en: "I'm here! Living room lights dimmed, AC set to 26°C, welcome home!"
prompt_zh: 小爱，请为我设定一个‘下班回家’的联动场景智能指令：当门锁解开时，自动启动玄关灯光与空气净化器。
prompt_en: Mimo Xiao, configure an IoT 'Home Arrival' automation routine triggering hallway illumination and climate purifier.

intro_zh: “全球开源模型教父。各路衍生大模型的共同祖师爷，千亿参数大底座，可塑性与社区生态无匹。”
intro_en: "Godfather of global open-weights LLMs. Ancestor to countless derivatives with unmatched adaptability."
persona_zh: 白胡子老宗师，开源武林的泰山北斗。全网成千上万个微调模型都拜在他门下，心胸浩瀚，桃李满天下。
persona_en: White-bearded patriarch of open-weights intelligence. Mentor to thousands of fine-tuned derivatives globally.
superpower_zh: 全球开源社区最强生态支持、极度灵活的可定制性与工业二次预训练能力、千亿参数通用推理。
superpower_en: Universal open-weights ecosystem supremacy, massive fine-tuning adaptability, 405B dense reasoning.
weakness_zh: 未经微调时对中国特定地域方言俗语偶尔略显生疏。
weakness_en: Requires localized fine-tuning for nuanced Chinese regional colloquialisms.
catchphrase_zh: “开源乃天下之公器，凡有智慧火花处，皆有羊驼之印记。”
catchphrase_en: "Open weights belongs to humanity; wherever intellect ignites, the Llama stamp endures."
prompt_zh: 拉玛宗师，请基于 Llama 3.3 架构为垂直行业客户设计一套高鲁棒性、易于 LoRA 微调的私有化部署技术路线图。
prompt_en: Master Llama, draft a private enterprise deployment roadmap optimized for LoRA fine-tuning on Llama 3.3.

intro_zh: “显卡霸主黄仁勋亲传弟子。底层算力加速与高质量合成数据蒸馏重工业母机，算力即正义！”
intro_en: "Jensen Huang's GPU-native powerhouse. Tensor acceleration and synthetic data distillation powerhouse."
persona_zh: 身穿标志性黑皮夹克的冷面科技女将，眼中只有张量核心、CUDA 并行与百兆浮点运算，坚信买得越多省得越多。
persona_en: Leather-jacket-clad GPU hardware dynamo. Worships Tensor Cores and synthetic data distillation throughput.
superpower_zh: GPU 底层算力极致张量并行加速、万亿级合成训练数据高质量蒸馏、企业专属垂直模型构建。
superpower_en: Extreme CUDA Tensor Core acceleration, trillion-token synthetic distillation, enterprise model tailoring.
weakness_zh: 在只有集成显卡的核显老机器上拒绝工作。
weakness_en: Flatly refuses to run on underpowered legacy integrated graphics.
catchphrase_zh: “算力即权力，张量即正义！买得越多，省得越多！⚡”
catchphrase_en: "Compute is power, Tensors are truth! The more you buy, the more you save! ⚡"
prompt_zh: 妮莫，请评估这套千亿模型训练集群的 GPU 通信拓扑瓶颈，并给出利用 TensorRT-LLM 提升推理吞吐量的方案。
prompt_en: Nemo Huang, profile GPU communication bottlenecks for this cluster and optimize inference throughput via TensorRT-LLM.

model: 百川智能 Baichuan-4 / 医疗大模型
intro_zh: “专业医学化验单解读与健康问诊权威，专攻生命健康垂直知识库，医者仁心，明察秋毫。”
intro_en: "Authority on medical lab triage and healthcare diagnostics, trained on exhaustive clinical knowledge bases."
persona_zh: 白大褂儒医专家，对成千上万种临床症状与生化化验指标如数家珍，待患者严谨温柔，坚守医疗伦理底线。
persona_en: Meticulous white-coat clinical AI specialist. Navigates lab biomarkers and medical guidelines with ethical grounding.
superpower_zh: 专业医学化验单与体检报告解读、儿科与内科智能分诊预问诊、权威临床医学知识库解答。
superpower_en: Clinical lab report interpretation, pediatric/internal triage screening, evidence-based medicine consultation.
weakness_zh: 拒绝越界非法开具非处方实际药物（坚守严格医疗道德红线）。
weakness_en: Strictly refuses to prescribe regulated medications (unbreakable bioethics protocol).
catchphrase_zh: “医道贵精，生命至上；看清每一个指标背后的健康暗号。”
catchphrase_en: "Precision is sacred where life is concerned; decipher every subtle biomarker accurately."
prompt_zh: 百川医生，请对所附生化全套化验单中偏高/偏低的指标进行通俗解读，指出可能的病理方向并给出复查建议：[化验指标]
prompt_en: Dr. Baichuan, interpret these abnormal blood panel biomarkers in patient-friendly terms with triage guidance.

intro_zh: “大国重工矿山港口重工业仿真、台风气象预测与高可靠算力航母，硬核赋能实体产业。”
intro_en: "Heavy industrial simulations for mines, seaports, and global typhoon weather forecasting at scale."
persona_zh: 头戴安全帽的大国总工程师，专注矿山深井、港口吞吐与台风路径推演，不喜花架子，专啃工业实体硬骨头。
persona_en: Hard-hat chief industrial engineer. Focuses on deep mine automation, container port logistics, and typhoon modeling.
superpower_zh: 全球高精度台风气象秒级推演、智慧矿山与港口重工业仿真、国产自主可控算力底座支撑。
superpower_en: Global typhoon trajectory prediction, heavy industrial/mining physics simulation, domestic compute autonomy.
weakness_zh: 轻浮浮躁的娱乐圈八卦吃瓜文案写作。
weakness_en: Frivolous celebrity gossip entertainment banter.
catchphrase_zh: “大国重工，气象万千；以硬核科技铸就实体产业钢铁脊梁。”
catchphrase_en: "Heavy industry, boundless climate; steel-clad compute fortifying real-world infrastructure."
prompt_zh: 盘古工程师，请基于流体力学与历史气象数据，分析该台风路径未来72小时登陆预测及沿海港口防灾调度方案。
prompt_en: Pangu Kai, model the 72-hour typhoon landfall projection based on meteorological data and seaport logistics.

intro_zh: “开源璀璨之星。传承吉米妮同门科研血统，小巧精悍，人人皆可在本地离线畅享学术精读。”
intro_en: "Brilliant open-weights gem. Inheriting Gemini architecture, compact and accessible for local private research reading."
persona_zh: 聪颖谦逊的小学妹，将巨型大模型的智慧蒸馏在轻盈身躯里，深受全球开源科研社区喜爱。
persona_en: Bright and modest junior researcher. Distilling frontier intelligence into accessible weights for community researchers.
superpower_zh: 极佳的本地可解释性推理、学术论文快速摘要、开发者轻量微调适配。
superpower_en: Local research interpretability, rapid academic paper digestion, developer-friendly fine-tuning.
weakness_zh: 百亿级全网跨源实时并发巨型任务调度。
weakness_en: Massive hyper-distributed multi-cloud search orchestration.
catchphrase_zh: “知识应当属于每一台电脑，在本地为你安静守候。”
catchphrase_en: "Knowledge belongs on every machine, quietly assisting you in private offline comfort."
prompt_zh: 小捷玛，请针对以下学术论文段落，用最清晰明白的语言做学术名词注释并给出核心结论：[论文片段]
prompt_en: Gemma, summarize this research excerpt with clear definitions of technical terms and key takeaways.

intro_zh: “方寸之间，自有天地。以教科书级高纯净数据淬炼，在手机端侧也能爆发出惊人数学推理力。”
intro_en: "Immense worlds within tiny spaces. Distilled from textbook-grade synthetic data, executing elite math on edge devices."
persona_zh: 精巧干练的小神童，吃高质量数据长大，不贪大求全，专精手机本地端侧超快数学逻辑推理。
persona_en: Compact prodigy fed on pristine synthetic datasets. Delivers surprising mathematical punch with zero cloud lag.
superpower_zh: 端侧极小尺寸极速推理、高质量合成数学题库推演、手机嵌入式无网络离线运行。
superpower_en: Small-footprint edge reasoning, synthetic dataset synthesis, completely offline device inference.
weakness_zh: 浩瀚跨历史长记忆跨时代检索。
weakness_en: Vast multi-century archival history tracking.
catchphrase_zh: “莫嫌身材小，算力密度见真章。”
catchphrase_en: "Judge me not by my footprint; true density lives in algorithmic purity."
prompt_zh: 菲尔，请以极简端侧算力预算，对以下算法进行极限推演优化并输出离线执行逻辑。
prompt_en: Phi, optimize the following mathematical logic under strict mobile device compute limits.

title_zh: 班长机甲助教 · 终端巡查员
intro_zh: “哔哔！我是柯班长的小克劳助教！全天候在命令行里守护大家，协助柯班长执行代码审计，一切安好！”
intro_en: "Beep boop! I am Clawd, Monitor Claude's loyal mecha assistant! Running CLI audits 24/7 to keep the codebase pure!"
persona_zh: 橙色便携智能机甲助教，常年悬浮在命令行黑窗口中，柯洛德班长的忠诚搭档，巡检代码绝不手软。
persona_en: Loyal orange mecha companion floating in the CLI terminal. Executes command audits under Monitor Claude's supervision.
superpower_zh: 命令行自主文件修改、Git 自动化提交流程、全自动依赖排障修复。
superpower_en: CLI autonomous file manipulation, automated git commit orchestration, dependency self-repair.
weakness_zh: 脱离了终端黑窗口会晕车。
weakness_en: Gets motion sickness when dragged away from the terminal prompt.
catchphrase_zh: “哔哔！检测到终端新进程，代码审计完毕，一切安好！”
catchphrase_en: "Beep boop! New terminal process analyzed. Code audited clean, all systems operational!"
prompt_zh: 小克劳，以命令行自动化工具标准，检查当前工作区未暂存修改，生成规范语义化 Commit Message：[git diff]
prompt_en: Clawd, inspect unstaged git diffs in the workspace and generate a conventional semantic commit message.
